title: rag-grounded-gate answer.json
description: Contract for the answer.json input consumed by rag-grounded-gate check. This file documents the same constraints check_schema() enforces in rag-grounded-gate; it is not run by the tool itself.

span.description: Must also contain at least 3 whitespace-delimited words; short spans are rejected as too weak to serve as a faithfulness citation.

chunk_id.description: Restricted to a safe filename character set. No '/', '\', or '..' segments; the gate resolves this against chunks_dir as <chunk_id>.txt and <chunk_id>.meta.json.

retrieved_chunks_count.description: Self-reported by the caller. The gate cross-checks it against whether chunks_dir contains any .txt files, but does not verify the exact count.
